pages.text: $(bold)In the depths of a mine, I found a diary.$(br2)Its previous owner wrote with hasty, feverish strokes:$(br)"These red stones... they breathe. The crystals they form can store some invisible 'force'."$(br2)I closed the diary and decided to test it myself. The first step: find a$(bold) Akaishi ore cluster$().

Akaishi ore clusters can be found across the world - in the$(bold) Overworld, Deepslate layers, the Nether and the End$().$(br2)The rarer the cluster's concentration, the more$(bold) Akaishi Crystals$() it drops.$(br2)Grab a pickaxe and head out. Your first Akaishi Crystal is where this research journey begins.
